about.title: About
about.subtitle: Learn more about this project
about.project: Castor is an open-source admin system built with Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Next.js, and React. It brings user, role, resource, asset, notification, audit, and dictionary management into one workspace.
about.interface: Navigation and available actions reflect the permissions of your current session. The API checks access for each protected request.
about.auth: Castor supports password, email code, and SMS code login. Its RBAC3 authorization combines role inheritance, separation of duties, and session role activation.
about.privacy: Information handled by Castor supports authentication, authorization, auditing, and the management workflows enabled in this deployment.
about.footer: Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: This policy describes how this application handles personal information. Data practices depend on the organization operating this deployment.
privacyPolicy.collection: Castor processes account and profile information, such as your name and email address, to identify users and provide access to enabled features.
privacyPolicy.auth: Castor handles login and account management. Authentication uses JWT, with RSA encryption for password transmission. The API enforces access using the effective permissions of the current RBAC3 session.
privacyPolicy.usage: Account information is used for authentication, authorization, auditing, and administration. Contact the operating organization for its data use and sharing policies.
privacyPolicy.deployment: Castor is self-hosted software. Data retention, backups, access policies, and external integrations depend on the deployment and are configured by the operating organization.
privacyPolicy.contact: Contact the operating organization for privacy requests. Software information is available on the project page.

home.heroTitle: A production-ready admin console, out of the box
home.heroSubtitle: Permissions, menus, files, auditing, notifications and localization are built end to end. Start from your business, not from scaffolding.

home.featuresSubtitle: Each capability runs through the database, API, permissions and UI, and is guarded by tests.
